_comment: Phase 71 example article — EMISSIVE. The defining observable is simply THAT IT GLOWS. Param-only. `emission_luminance` must be > 0 or it would not glow (71.7's master-conformance makes that a build failure rather than a dark sign). Deliberately a saturated magenta at high luminance — unmistakable at the smoke, and distinct from the IMRSV_MissingMaterial sentinel's magenta by being a REAL article on the Emissive master rather than the broken-material fallback. Routes by class emissive.
